svg.title: Joint density, slice, and normalized conditional distribution
svg.desc: Rho 0.6, X fixed at 1. Conditional mean 0.6, variance 0.64. Both normal supports extend beyond the finite drawing window.

g.text: From a joint-density slice to a conditional density
Standard bivariate normal: rho = 0.6; observed X = 1
Equal coordinate scales; no random samples
Same y-axis: three different density functions
Conditional f(y | 1): divide slice by phi(1)
